name: Dr. Sarah Johnson
bio: Dr. Johnson leads our foundation with over 20 years of experience in space education and community development. She has pioneered numerous initiatives that have impacted thousands of students.

name: Rahul Sharma
bio: Rahul oversees our education initiatives and has successfully implemented numerous programs for underprivileged children. He specializes in curriculum development and program coordination.

name: Ananya Patel
bio: Ananya builds relationships with local communities and ensures our programs address their specific needs. She has extensive experience in stakeholder engagement.

name: Dr. Michael Chen
bio: Dr. Chen leads our technical initiatives, developing innovative space education technologies and digital learning platforms. He has a PhD in Computer Science and 15 years in ed-tech.

name: Lisa Rodriguez
bio: Lisa conducts cutting-edge research in space science education and develops experimental learning modules. She has published numerous papers on STEM education.

name: James Wilson
bio: James brings 25 years of aerospace industry experience to our advisory board. He provides strategic guidance on technical partnerships and industry relations.

name: Dr. Priya Singh
bio: Dr. Singh leads our technical development team, creating innovative educational tools and platforms. She specializes in AI-driven learning systems.

name: Carlos Martinez
bio: Carlos manages day-to-day operations, logistics, and administrative functions. He ensures smooth coordination between all departments and programs.

name: Emma Thompson
bio: Emma specializes in special projects and initiatives, particularly our international space education partnerships and outreach programs.

name: David Kim
bio: David manages our volunteer program, recruiting and coordinating hundreds of dedicated volunteers who support our mission across various programs.

name: Maria Garcia
bio: Maria provides expert consultation on educational methodologies and curriculum development. She has extensive experience in STEM education reform.

name: Alex Turner
bio: Alex develops educational software and digital tools for our space education programs. He specializes in interactive learning applications.

name: Sophie Anderson
bio: Sophie leads our marketing and communications efforts, raising awareness about our programs and building partnerships with educational institutions.

name: Raj Patel
bio: Raj is a passionate volunteer who assists with event coordination and student mentoring. He brings enthusiasm and dedication to all our programs.

name: Jennifer Lee
bio: Jennifer supports our research initiatives, collecting data and assisting with educational program evaluations and impact assessments.
